name: Drake Walker
source:
Drake Walker, a character in The Royal Romance and The Royal Heir series, is [url=/c86785/]Liam Rys[/url]'s best friend and one of Your Character's potential love interests. He is first seen in Book 1, Chapter 1. 

Drake is the down-to-earth, realistic "commoner" in his circle of friends. To most, he comes off as snarky, sarcastic and generally closed-off. He holds a cynical view of society, specifically the court of Cordonia and the "back-stabbing" politics that goes with it. His friendship with Liam appears mismatched, as he did not have the lineage to be introduced into the Prince's circle of friends. However, he is not ashamed of his background and prides himself in being self-sufficient. [spoiler]Once he opens up, Your Character begins to notice that he is observant, caring, and very loyal to his friends. If romanced, he is also self-deprecating, insecure, and vulnerable around Your Character.[/spoiler]

[Edited from the [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Drake_Walker]Wiki[/url]]
